snippet.title: Box Knight | Indie Fan Fest | Feb 2026
snippet.description:
Once a happy small business has been overrun by a dark power, a corporate takeover. They banned Friday night drinks and it's up to you the Box Knight to bring back the good vibes.

Fight monstrous abstractions of your most toxic co-workers and quest your way up the tower to defeat the evil CEO in glorious battle or die trying...level up in your safe space and try it all again next week.
